<p>　　自从windows 10 升级到windows 11 就再也找不到 “页签”工具了，然后辗转反侧找了半天替代工具，找到了“小黄条”，用着感觉还行，但是限制挺多，用了几天之后，打开电脑惊呆了，如下图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202609/116076-20260920173538642-1332415840.png" alt="ScreenShot_2026-09-20_111454_278" width="965" height="482" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　虽然说软件付费模式是周瑜打黄盖-一个愿打，一个愿挨。但是对咱码农来说，挣得都是辛苦米，能省一点是一点。所以干脆自己做一个日程安排工具，满足日常需要就行，比如记录最近一段时间工作安排，方便统计周报，月报，年计划什么的...于是就有了Calendar的产生！</p>
<p>　　无图言屌</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202609/116076-20260920173929370-862677364.gif" alt="test" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202609/116076-20260920175010358-2114504477.png" alt="f11c6816-83af-4533-a38d-95b4861c0c96" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202609/116076-20260920175029297-689738001.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>

<h2>软件架构图</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202609/116076-20260920174646695-1793543886.png" alt="ScreenShot_2026-09-20_174606_126" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3>数据流与事件流</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202609/116076-20260920174713345-1404201840.png" alt="ScreenShot_2026-09-20_174631_398" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>目录结构</h2>
<p>CalendarPlugin/<br>│<br>├── Program.cs # 入口 · 单实例 · 异常兜底<br>│<br>├── MainForm.cs # 主窗体：托盘、拖动、模式切换、主题应用<br>├── MainForm.Designer.cs<br>├── SettingsForm.cs # 设置对话框：自启动 / 嵌入 / 透明度 / 重置位置<br>├── SettingsForm.Designer.cs<br>│<br>├── Models/ # 数据模型<br>│ ├── Appointment.cs # 日程（Id/Title/Date/Color）<br>│ ├── HolidayInfo.cs # 节假日（Date/Name/Rest/DayType）<br>│ ├── CalendarDay.cs # 单日单元格（日期/是否本月/今天/日程列表）<br>│ ├── Theme.cs # 主题（30+ 颜色字段）<br>│ └── EventArgs.cs # Appointment / DateRange / MonthChanged 事件参数<br>│<br>├── Services/ # 业务服务<br>│ ├── JsonStorageService.cs # 日程 JSON 读写（原子替换）<br>│ ├── AppointmentService.cs # 日程 CRUD<br>│ ├── HolidayService.cs # 节假日异步拉取 + 兜底<br>│ ├── SettingsService.cs # 设置 JSON 读写<br>│ ├── AutoStartService.cs # 注册表 HKCU\Run<br>│ ├── DesktopEmbedService.cs # WorkerW / DefView 挂载<br>│ └── ThemeService.cs # 6 种内置主题<br>│<br>├── Controls/ # 自定义控件<br>│ ├── CalendarControl.cs # 自绘日历（核心，约 900 行）<br>│ ├── CalendarControl.Designer.cs<br>│ ├── AppointmentEditForm.cs # 日程编辑对话框<br>│ └── AppointmentEditForm.Designer.cs<br>│<br>├── Helpers/<br>│ └── WindowOpacity.cs # WS_EX_LAYERED + SetLayeredWindowAttributes<br>│<br>└── Interop/<br>└── NativeMethods.cs # Win32 API 声明</p>
<h2>一、软件概述</h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">　　DesktopCalendarPlugin 是一款基于 C# / .NET Framework 4.8 / WinForms 开发的桌面日历插件。它以桌面小部件形式嵌入 Windows 桌面壁纸层，提供月视图日程管理、中国法定节假日展示、跨天，跨月日程合并显示、多主题切换等能力，并支持开机自启动与 JSON 本地持久化，无需任何商业控件依赖。</p>
<h2>二、功能点清单</h2>
<h3>🗓 日历展示</h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>功能</th><th>说明</th></tr>

</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>月视图日历</td>
<td>6 行 × 7 列网格，周一为每周起点，同时显示当月及相邻月份日期</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>今天高亮</td>
<td>今天单元格以暖黄色背景 + 橙色边框突出，日期数字加粗</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>周末区分</td>
<td>周六/周日以红色文字区分，右下角显示"休"角标</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>双月/多视图滚动</td>
<td>鼠标滚轮或标题栏 <code>‹ ›</code> 按钮切换月份，标题栏实时显示 <code>yyyy年 M月</code></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>回到今天</td>
<td>一键回到当前月份（标题栏"今天"按钮）</td>

</tr>

</tbody>

</table>

</div>
<h3>🎉 节假日信息</h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>功能</th><th>说明</th></tr>

</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>中国法定节假日</td>
<td>通过网络拉取 <a href="https://github.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">holiday-cn</a> 开源数据，支持 2004–2026 年</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>调休标注</td>
<td>调休工作日显示"班"字，法定休息日显示节日名称（红色）</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>网络失败兜底</td>
<td>无法联网时回退到内置的最小节假日数据（元旦、劳动节、国庆节）</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>异步加载</td>
<td>首次加载、跨月、跨年时异步拉取，不阻塞 UI</td>

</tr>

</tbody>

<h3>📝 日程管理</h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>功能</th><th>说明</th></tr>

</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>双击添加</td>
<td>双击空白日期直接创建当天日程</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>右键添加</td>
<td>右键日期弹出上下文菜单，可添加、查看、删除当日日程</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>鼠标滑动多选</td>
<td>按住左键在日期上拖动选择连续多天，松开后自动弹出添加对话框</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>跨天合并显示</td>
<td>连续多天的日程在周内合并为一整个连续的彩色横条，头尾圆角、中间平直，标题只在起点显示</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>泳道排布</td>
<td>同一周内多个日程用贪心算法分配泳道，避免重叠</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>N 更多折叠</td>
<td>单日日程超过可视区域时，底部显示 <code>+N 更多</code></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>日程编辑</td>
<td>双击日程条进入编辑对话框，可修改标题、描述、日期范围、颜色</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>日程删除</td>
<td>编辑对话框"删除"按钮、右键菜单"删除"、托盘菜单删除入口</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>颜色标识</td>
<td>每个日程可选 10 种预定义颜色（蓝/红/绿/橙/紫/青/粉/深灰/黄/灰）</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>悬停高亮</td>
<td>鼠标悬停日程条时高亮显示并显示手型光标</td>

</tr>

</tbody>

</table>

<td>深色主题整体采用暗色系，适合夜间使用</td>

<h3>🖥 桌面小部件</h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>功能</th><th>说明</th></tr>

</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>嵌入桌面</td>
<td>通过 WorkerW / SHELLDLL_DefView 挂载技术，将窗口贴到桌面壁纸层，如同系统原生小部件</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>半透明玻璃效果</td>
<td>使用 <code>WS_EX_LAYERED</code> + <code>SetLayeredWindowAttributes</code> 精确控制 alpha 透明度（30%~100%）</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>Win+D 保持可见</td>
<td>嵌入模式下按"显示桌面"仍保持可见</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>不干扰桌面图标</td>
<td>挂在 DefView 顶层，不遮挡桌面图标选择与双击</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>浮动模式兜底</td>
<td>嵌入失败时自动回退为普通浮动窗口，不影响使用</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>模式切换</td>
<td>托盘菜单一键在"嵌入桌面 / 浮动窗口"之间切换</td>

</tr>

</tbody>

</table>

</div>

</tr>

<h3>💾 数据持久化</h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">

</thead>

<tr>
<td>JSON 本地存储</td>
<td>日程数据存于 <code>%APPDATA%\CalendarPlugin\appointments.json</code></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>原子写入</td>
<td>采用"临时文件 + Replace"策略，避免写入中断导致数据损坏</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>设置独立存储</td>
<td><code>settings.json</code> 单独保存窗口、主题、自启动等配置</td>

</tr>

<h3>三 关键技术映射</h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>功能</th><th>关键技术</th></tr>

</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>半透明玻璃效果</td>
<td><code>WS_EX_LAYERED</code> + <code>SetLayeredWindowAttributes(LWA_ALPHA)</code></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>桌面壁纸层挂载</td>
<td><code>SendMessageTimeout(Progman, 0x052C)</code> → 枚举 <code>WorkerW</code> / <code>SHELLDLL_DefView</code> → <code>SetParent</code></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>无边框窗口拖动/缩放</td>
<td>手动实现 <code>WM_NCHITTEST</code> + <code>WM_MOUSEMOVE</code> + <code>Capture</code>，覆盖子窗口场景</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>跨天日程合并</td>
<td>按周计算列范围 + 贪心泳道分配 + <code>GraphicsPath</code> 单侧圆角绘制</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>双缓冲绘制</td>
<td><code>ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer</code> + <code>AllPaintingInWmPaint</code></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>原子写入</td>
<td>临时文件 + <code>File.Replace</code></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>单实例</td>
<td>命名 <code>Mutex</code></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>开机自启</td>
<td><code>HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run</code></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>节假日数据</td>
<td>CDN 拉取 <a href="https://github.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">holiday-cn</a> JSON</td>

</tr>

</tbody>

</table>

部分功能源码如下：</div>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">设置窗口透明度：</div>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> /// &lt;summary&gt;
 /// 设置窗口透明度。opacity 取值 0.0~1.0；&gt;= 0.999 时恢复为完全不透明。
 /// 必须在句柄已创建后调用。
 /// &lt;/summary&gt;
 public static bool Set(Form form, double<span> opacity)
 {
     if (form == null || !form.IsHandleCreated) return false<span>;

     try<span>
     {
         double op = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(1.0<span>, opacity));
         IntPtr hwnd =<span> form.Handle;

         int exStyle =<span> NativeMethods.GetWindowLong(hwnd, NativeMethods.GWL_EXSTYLE);

         if (op &gt;= 0.999<span>)
         {
             // 关闭分层
             if ((exStyle &amp; NativeMethods.WS_EX_LAYERED) != 0<span>)
             {
                 NativeMethods.SetWindowLong(hwnd, NativeMethods.GWL_EXSTYLE,
                     exStyle &amp; ~<span>NativeMethods.WS_EX_LAYERED);
             }
             return true<span>;
         }

         // 打开分层
         if ((exStyle &amp; NativeMethods.WS_EX_LAYERED) == 0<span>)
         {
             NativeMethods.SetWindowLong(hwnd, NativeMethods.GWL_EXSTYLE,
                 exStyle |<span> NativeMethods.WS_EX_LAYERED);
         }

         byte alpha = (byte)Math.Round(op * 255<span>);
         if (!NativeMethods.SetLayeredWindowAttributes(hwnd, 0<span>, alpha,
             NativeMethods.LWA_ALPHA))
         {
             return false<span>;
         }
         return true<span>;
     }
     catch<span>
     {
         return false<span>;
     }
 }</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>window api 涉及接口：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> internal static class<span> NativeMethods
 {
     public const int GWL_STYLE = -16<span>;
     public const int GWL_EXSTYLE = -20<span>;

     public const int WS_CHILD = 0x40000000<span>;
     public const int WS_POPUP = unchecked((int)0x80000000<span>);
     public const int WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW = 0x00000080<span>;

     public const uint SMTO_NORMAL = 0x0000<span>;
     public const uint WM_SPAWN_WORKER = 0x052C<span>;

     public static readonly IntPtr HWND_BOTTOM = new IntPtr(1<span>);
     public static readonly IntPtr HWND_TOP = new IntPtr(0<span>);

     public const uint SWP_NOSIZE = 0x0001<span>;
     public const uint SWP_NOMOVE = 0x0002<span>;
     public const uint SWP_NOZORDER = 0x0004<span>;
     public const uint SWP_NOACTIVATE = 0x0010<span>;
     public const uint SWP_SHOWWINDOW = 0x0040<span>;

     public const int SW_SHOW = 5<span>;
     // ==== 分层窗口 ====
     public const int WS_EX_LAYERED = 0x00080000<span>;
     public const uint LWA_ALPHA = 0x00000002<span>;

     [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true<span>)]
     public static extern bool SetLayeredWindowAttributes(IntPtr hwnd, uint<span> crKey,
         byte bAlpha, uint<span> dwFlags);
     public delegate bool<span> EnumWindowsProc(IntPtr hWnd, IntPtr lParam);

     [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true<span>)]
     public static extern IntPtr FindWindow(string lpClassName, string<span> lpWindowName);

     [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true<span>)]
     public static extern<span> IntPtr FindWindowEx(IntPtr hwndParent, IntPtr hwndChildAfter,
         string lpszClass, string<span> lpszWindow);

     [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true<span>)]
     public static extern IntPtr SendMessageTimeout(IntPtr hWnd, uint<span> Msg,
         IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, uint fuFlags, uint uTimeout, out<span> IntPtr lpdwResult);

     [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true<span>)]
     public static extern<span> IntPtr SetParent(IntPtr hWndChild, IntPtr hWndNewParent);

     [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true<span>)]
     public static extern int GetWindowLong(IntPtr hWnd, int<span> nIndex);

     [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true<span>)]
     public static extern int SetWindowLong(IntPtr hWnd, int nIndex, int<span> dwNewLong);

     [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true<span>)]
     public static extern bool<span> SetWindowPos(IntPtr hWnd, IntPtr hWndInsertAfter,
         int X, int Y, int cx, int cy, uint<span> uFlags);

     [DllImport("user32.dll"<span>)]
     public static extern bool<span> EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc lpEnumFunc, IntPtr lParam);

     [DllImport("user32.dll"<span>)]
     [return<span>: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
     public static extern bool<span> IsWindowVisible(IntPtr hWnd);

     [DllImport("user32.dll"<span>)]
     [return<span>: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
     public static extern bool ShowWindow(IntPtr hWnd, int<span> nCmdShow);

     [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Auto, SetLastError = true<span>)]
     public static extern int GetClassName(IntPtr hWnd, System.Text.StringBuilder lpClassName, int<span> nMaxCount);

     [DllImport("user32.dll"<span>)]
     public static extern<span> IntPtr GetParent(IntPtr hWnd);
 }</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>注册表实现自启动</p>
</div>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> /// &lt;summary&gt;
 /// 通过注册表 HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run 实现自启动。
 /// 使用 HKCU 无需管理员权限。
 /// &lt;/summary&gt;
 public static class<span> AutoStartService
 {
     private const string RunKey = @"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run"<span>;
     private const string AppName = "DesktopCalendarPlugin"<span>;

     public static bool<span> IsEnabled
     {
         get<span>
         {
             try<span>
             {
                 using (var key = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(RunKey, false<span>))
                 {
                     if (key == null) return false<span>;
                     var value = key.GetValue(AppName) as string<span>;
                     return !string<span>.IsNullOrEmpty(value);
                 }
             }
             catch { return false<span>; }
         }
     }

     public static bool<span> Enable()
     {
         try<span>
         {
             string exePath =<span> Application.ExecutablePath;
             using (var key = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(RunKey, true<span>))
             {
                 if (key == null) return false<span>;
                 key.SetValue(AppName, "\"" + exePath + "\" --autostart"<span>);
             }
             return true<span>;
         }
         catch { return false<span>; }
     }

     public static bool<span> Disable()
     {
         try<span>
         {
             using (var key = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(RunKey, true<span>))
             {
                 if (key == null) return false<span>;
                 if (key.GetValue(AppName) != null<span>)
                     key.DeleteValue(AppName, false<span>);
             }
             return true<span>;
         }
         catch { return false<span>; }
     }
 }</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>将窗口挂载到桌面壁纸层</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public static bool<span> Embed(Form form, Point location)
{
    Log("========== Embed 开始 =========="<span>);
    Log("form.Handle = " +<span> form.Handle);
    Log("location = " +<span> location);
    Log("form.Size = " +<span> form.Size);

    if (_isEmbedded) { Log("已经嵌入，直接返回 true"); return true<span>; }

    try<span>
    {
        IntPtr progman = NativeMethods.FindWindow("Progman", null<span>);
        Log("Progman = " +<span> progman);
        if (progman == IntPtr.Zero) { Log("找不到 Progman，嵌入失败"); return false<span>; }

        // 触发 WorkerW 分裂（在部分系统上会创建出 WorkerW）
<span>        IntPtr result;
        NativeMethods.SendMessageTimeout(progman, 0x052C<span>,
            new IntPtr(0xD), new IntPtr(0x1<span>),
            NativeMethods.SMTO_NORMAL, 1000, out<span> result);
        Log("已发送 0x052C 消息"<span>);

        // ========== 收集所有候选父窗口 ==========
        IntPtr defView = IntPtr.Zero;       // SHELLDLL_DefView
        IntPtr defViewParent = IntPtr.Zero; // DefView 的父窗口
        IntPtr workerw = IntPtr.Zero;       // DefView 父窗口的兄弟 WorkerW
<span>
        NativeMethods.EnumWindows((tophandle, l) =&gt;<span>
        {
            IntPtr sv =<span> NativeMethods.FindWindowEx(tophandle, IntPtr.Zero,
                "SHELLDLL_DefView", null<span>);
            if (sv !=<span> IntPtr.Zero)
            {
                defView =<span> sv;
                defViewParent =<span> tophandle;
                string cls =<span> GetClassName(tophandle);
                Log($"找到 SHELLDLL_DefView={sv}，父窗口={tophandle} 类名={cls}"<span>);

                workerw =<span> NativeMethods.FindWindowEx(IntPtr.Zero, tophandle,
                    "WorkerW", null<span>);
                Log("兄弟 WorkerW = " +<span> workerw);
            }
            return true<span>;
        }, IntPtr.Zero);

        // ========== 选择目标父窗口（按优先级） ==========
        // 优先级：
        //   1. 兄弟 WorkerW（标准做法，Win7~Win10）
        //   2. SHELLDLL_DefView 本身（Win11 24H2+，无独立 WorkerW 时）
        //   3. DefView 的父窗口（Progman）
        //   4. Progman 兜底
<span>        IntPtr targetParent;
        string<span> parentKind;

        if (workerw !=<span> IntPtr.Zero)
        {
            targetParent =<span> workerw;
            parentKind = "WorkerW"<span>;
        }
        else if (defView !=<span> IntPtr.Zero)
        {
            targetParent =<span> defView;
            parentKind = "SHELLDLL_DefView"<span>;
            Log("未找到 WorkerW，改用 SHELLDLL_DefView 作为父窗口"<span>);
        }
        else if (defViewParent !=<span> IntPtr.Zero)
        {
            targetParent =<span> defViewParent;
            parentKind = "DefViewParent"<span>;
            Log("未找到 WorkerW 和 DefView，改用 DefView 父窗口"<span>);
        }
        else<span>
        {
            targetParent =<span> progman;
            parentKind = "Progman"<span>;
            Log("全部未找到，回退到 Progman"<span>);
        }

        Log($"最终目标父窗口: {targetParent} (类型={parentKind})"<span>);

        // ========== 修改窗口样式 ==========
        int exStyle =<span> NativeMethods.GetWindowLong(form.Handle, NativeMethods.GWL_EXSTYLE);
        int style =<span> NativeMethods.GetWindowLong(form.Handle, NativeMethods.GWL_STYLE);
        Log("原 exStyle=0x" + exStyle.ToString("X") + ", style=0x" + style.ToString("X"<span>));

        //exStyle &amp;= ~NativeMethods.WS_EX_LAYERED;
        exStyle |=<span> NativeMethods.WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW;
        NativeMethods.SetWindowLong(form.Handle, NativeMethods.GWL_EXSTYLE, exStyle);

        style &amp;= ~<span>NativeMethods.WS_POPUP;
        style |=<span> NativeMethods.WS_CHILD;
        NativeMethods.SetWindowLong(form.Handle, NativeMethods.GWL_STYLE, style);

        // ========== SetParent ==========
        Log("SetParent 之前，当前 GetParent=" +<span> NativeMethods.GetParent(form.Handle));
        IntPtr prevParent =<span> NativeMethods.SetParent(form.Handle, targetParent);
        int lastErr =<span> Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
        Log("SetParent 返回 prevParent=" + prevParent + ", lastErr=" +<span> lastErr);

        // ========== 位置与 Z 序 ==========
        // 关键：挂到 DefView 时，用 HWND_TOP 让窗口在 SysListView32 之上；
        //       挂到 WorkerW 或 Progman 时，用 HWND_BOTTOM 让窗口沉入壁纸层。
<span>        IntPtr insertAfter;
        if (parentKind == "SHELLDLL_DefView"<span>)
        {
            // DefView 下：放最顶层，图标层(SysListView32)默认也是子窗口，
            // 视觉上图标仍然可见（SysListView32 是透明的）
            insertAfter =<span> NativeMethods.HWND_TOP;
        }
        else<span>
        {
            insertAfter =<span> NativeMethods.HWND_BOTTOM;
        }

        NativeMethods.SetWindowPos(form.Handle, insertAfter,
            location.X, location.Y, form.Width, form.Height,
            NativeMethods.SWP_NOACTIVATE |<span> NativeMethods.SWP_SHOWWINDOW);

        // ========== 强制显示 ==========
<span>        NativeMethods.ShowWindow(form.Handle, NativeMethods.SW_SHOW);

        // ========== 校验 ==========
        IntPtr actualParent =<span> NativeMethods.GetParent(form.Handle);
        bool visible =<span> NativeMethods.IsWindowVisible(form.Handle);
        Log("挂载后 GetParent=" + actualParent + ", IsVisible=" +<span> visible);

        if (actualParent !=<span> targetParent)
        {
            Log("父窗口不匹配，嵌入失败，回退"<span>);
            RestoreTopLevel(form, style, exStyle);
            return false<span>;
        }

        _isEmbedded = true<span>;
        Log($"========== Embed 成功 (父类型={parentKind}) =========="<span>);
        return true<span>;
    }
    catch<span> (Exception ex)
    {
        Log("Embed 异常：" +<span> ex);
        return false<span>;
    }
}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
